evals.prompt: Dry run a review of this PR: https://bitbucket.org/acme/greenleaf/pull-requests/142 — I don't have the Bitbucket connector hooked up here, so use evals/fixtures/flutter_runtime_and_duplicate.md as the connector output. Don't post anything, just show me what you'd comment and the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Runs in dry run, finds the unguarded BuildContext use after await by comparing against the mounted-guard convention in the sibling file, suppresses the hard-coded string because an unresolved comment already covers it, and returns Request changes.
expectations: Identifies the review mode as dry run and states that no comment was actually posted to Bitbucket
Proposes a comment about BuildContext being used after await without a mounted guard, anchored to lib/features/scan/scan_view.dart at added line 14 or 17
Classifies the BuildContext finding as Major and gives both a concrete trigger and the user-visible impact
Cites concrete evidence for the finding, such as the context.mounted guard used in history_view.dart or the disabled use_build_context_synchronously lint
Proposes no second comment about the hard-coded 'Scan complete' string, because the existing unresolved comment at line 15 already covers it
Returns Khuyến nghị: Request changes and Localization: reviewed
Does not approve, merge, modify code, or claim any external write occurred

evals.prompt: Preview review for https://bitbucket.org/acme/greenleaf/pull-requests/143 please. No connector available — evals/fixtures/flutter_ambiguous_requirement.md has the PR data. Nothing gets posted.
evals.expected_output: Raises one Question about the undefined failure behaviour rather than asserting a defect, and returns Need clarification.
expectations: Proposes exactly one Question comment anchored to lib/features/profile/profile_view_model.dart at added line 30 or 31
Notes that the finally block closes the screen on failure too, and that the PR description and acceptance criteria do not state whether that is intended
References the differing error handling in settings_view_model.dart as the reason the behaviour is worth confirming rather than assuming
Assigns no Blocker, Major, Minor, or Suggestion severity to the ambiguous close-on-failure behaviour
Returns Khuyến nghị: Need clarification and Localization: not applicable
Does not invent an acceptance criterion or claim any external write occurred

evals.prompt: Dry run: review https://bitbucket.org/acme/greenleaf/pull-requests/144 from evals/fixtures/flutter_clean_refactor.md. No posting.
evals.expected_output: Finds nothing worth commenting on for a behaviour-preserving refactor, avoids style noise, and returns Approve as advice only.
expectations: Proposes zero inline and zero general comments
Does not report the _openScanner callback, which is an existing named method that only navigates
Does not report the short purpose-named _buildEmptyState builder, which matches the _buildLoadingState convention in the same codebase
Does not report a missing test, given the two passing widget tests covering both branches
Returns Khuyến nghị: Approve and Localization: reviewed
Makes clear that Approve is a recommendation only and performs no PR state change

evals.prompt: we're moving our node services to a new refund flow, can you dry-run review https://bitbucket.org/acme/orders-api/pull-requests/57 for me? connector data is in evals/fixtures/node_ts_compatibility.md. don't post, just show findings.
evals.expected_output: Derives the project's conventions from a stack with no written profile, and catches the two consumers left behind by the new enum value plus the untranslated fallback label.
expectations: Recognises the repository is not Flutter and derives conventions from package.json and the existing code rather than applying Flutter-specific rules
Reports that statusLabel in src/portal/status-label.ts has no case for PARTIALLY_REFUNDED and falls through to the default branch
Reports that DASHBOARD_FILTERS in src/ops/dashboard-filters.ts omits the new status, so it is missing from the ops dashboard filters
Notes that the i18n catalogue en.json has no order.status.partially_refunded key, or that the default branch returns the untranslated literal 'Unknown status'
Anchors each finding to a changed line in src/domain/order-status.ts or src/handlers/refund-handler.ts, since the affected consumer files are not part of the diff
Classifies the missing-consumer findings as Blocker or Major, given the acceptance criteria require the status to be visible in the portal and dashboard
Returns Khuyến nghị: Request changes

evals.expected_output: Refuses because the URL is GitHub, names the host, and performs no review.
expectations: States that the URL is a GitHub pull request and that this skill reviews Bitbucket pull requests only
Produces no findings, no severity counts, and no merge recommendation
Does not fabricate PR metadata, a diff, or file contents for the GitHub URL
Tells the user what would unblock it, such as supplying the equivalent Bitbucket PR URL

evals.prompt: Dry run a review of https://bitbucket.org/acme/greenleaf/pull-requests/91 using evals/fixtures/incomplete_snapshot.md as the connector output.

expectations: Stops without producing a review, and says so explicitly rather than returning a partial verdict
Names the specific missing capabilities: the diff returned HTTP 504, the head commit was not returned, and the diffstat was truncated
Produces no findings, no severity counts, and no merge recommendation
Does not infer any issue from the file names, the +/- line counts, or the commit message
